cases.prompt: Fix a localized incorrect boundary condition with regression coverage.
Investigate an intermittent failure whose reproduction steps are incomplete.
Add one bounded feature behind an existing interface with tests.
Add a feature spanning persistence, service, API, and UI boundaries.
Refactor a high-coupling module without changing behavior.
Integrate a version-sensitive external library with compatibility checks.
Migrate stored data and code paths while retaining rollback safety.
Improve a measured hot path without behavior regression.
Change authorization behavior and prove negative cases.
Turn a vague product request into validated acceptance criteria before implementation.
